name: homebase
description: Homebase, your team's asset library: find, fetch, upload, tag and organise brand and campaign assets from your agent.

interface.longDescription:
Homebase is an asset library for marketing teams, agencies and the agents they work with. Connect your Homebase workspace to find, look at and organise its images, videos, PDFs, documents, links and design embeds.

What you can do:
- Search in plain words, such as "latest files from the spring launch" or "logo pngs from last week". Homebase reads bucket names, dates, file types and tags, and says how it understood the question.
- See an asset's preview, details, version history and a one-hour download link.
- List buckets (one per campaign, client or project) and what is in them, and get a bucket's client share link to send yourself.
- Create buckets, add or remove assets, tag and rename assets, and import a file or web page from a public URL.
- Delete assets after a preview you confirm. Deleted assets go to Recently deleted, where a workspace owner or admin can restore them for 30 days.

Limitations: you need a Homebase account and workspace. ChatGPT can't upload files from your computer; import them from a public URL or upload them in the Homebase web app. Homebase never sends, emails or posts anything to clients. Deleting and restoring need the Delete permission, which only workspace owners and admins can grant when connecting. In Codex, the bundled homebase CLI can also upload local files.
